title: Infinity Dragon Rider
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a green two-headed infinity dragon forming an 8-shaped loop against a swirling purple and orange sky. A child-like figure wearing a red cape and leafy crown rides the upper dragon head while raising one hand, surrounded by numerous colorful stylized animals scattered across the dark purple background.
prompt: A vibrant folk-surreal painting featuring a large green two-headed dragon twisted into an infinity loop, with intricate colorful patterns on its body. A small figure with leafy crown and flowing red cape rides the top head, one arm raised. The background is deep purple filled with dozens of stylized animals in bright colors. Swirling orange and purple sky above with a circular emblem containing text and animal silhouettes in the upper right corner.
